summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Wyoming, Delaware, a town in Kent County, United States. It states the town's naming origin, its membership in the Dover metropolitan area, and its 2010 census population.
one_line: Wyoming, Delaware is a town in Kent County, named after Pennsylvania's Wyoming Valley and part of the Dover metropolitan area.
key_facts: Wyoming is a town in Kent County, Delaware, United States.
Wyoming, Delaware was named after the Wyoming Valley in Pennsylvania.
Wyoming, Delaware is part of the Dover, Delaware Metropolitan Statistical Area.
The population of Wyoming, Delaware was 1,313 at the 2010 census.
